verdict.rationale: mParticle's marketing site claims it can score likelihood to churn, convert, or grow in value and then activate audiences on those scores, which covers the predictive-score and targeting halves of the story. Nothing in the pack documents computed or calculated traits on profiles, and the predictive claim rests on a single homepage line with no product documentation. Missing for 10: documentation of computed/calculated attributes on profiles, in-depth docs on how predictive scores are built and attached to profiles, hands-on or independent corroboration.
